review.why: Earns press and podcast coverage: story angles, pitch quality bar, press page, newsjacking, inbound requests and crisis response templates.
review.summary: Treats PR as a multiplier for distribution, with four modes (reactive, proactive, inbound, owned). It gives a seven-point pitch checklist, a press page and media kit list, measurement beyond ad-value equivalents, and a crisis section with severity tiers and a first-60-minutes checklist. Detailed playbooks and templates are in eight reference files.
strengths: Pitch checklist ends with: if any answer is no, don't send
Crisis section starts with facts, one spokesperson and a holding statement, and calls in legal early
Says plainly that press rarely drives direct conversions
cautions: Eight reference files hold the pitching and crisis detail and are not read here
